cues.text: Can I help you?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Yes, I've just moved to this area with my wife and children and I'd like to know where we can all register with a doctor at a Health Centre.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Okay. Well, there's (Example) Doctor Green at The Harvey Clinic. We always recommend her for babies, because she's very good with them and she runs a special clinic.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh...actually my youngest child is five, so that wouldn't be any good for us.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Is there anywhere else I could try?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes, the Eshcol Health Practice is the next one on my list.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: How do you spell that?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: E-S-H-C-O-L. And it's Doctor Fuller, who has space on his list. The clinic only opened a year ago, so the facilities are all very modern.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: That sounds good.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: And it's particularly good if you're busy during the day, because they also do appointments in the evening. They're closed on Saturday, though. The only other place on the list is the Health Centre on Shore Lane. You can register with Doctor Gormley, that's G-O-R-M-L-E-Y. He's new there, but the centre has a very good reputation.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh yes, I think I know the road.That would be the best one. Thanks. Could you tell me, will all their services be free?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Erm...there are usually some small charges that doctors make. Let me see what it says bout the Shore Lane Centre. If you need to be vaccinated before and trips abroad, you won't have to pay for this. Erm, what else? The sports injury treatment service operates on a paying basis, as does the nutritional therapy service. Some health centres do offer alternative therapies like homeopathy as part of their pay-to-use service. Shore Lane are hoping to do this soon - I think they may start with acupuncture. And finally, if you need to prove you're healthy or haven't had any serious injuries before a new employer will accept you, you can get a free fitness check-up there, but you'd most likely have to pay for insurance medicals though.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Okay, thanks.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: You might also be interested to know the Centre is running a pilot scheme of talks for patients. I've got the list here. Actually, they look very interesting.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: What sort of things?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well, the first one's about giving up smoking. It's next week, the twenty-fifth of February, at 7 pm, and that's in Room 4. It says, the talk will stress the health benefits particularly for people with asthma or heart disease.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: That sounds very interesting.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: There's also a talk for families with children. It's on Healthy Eating, and takes place on the first of March at five o'clock.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Will that be at the Health Centre?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Erm, actually it's at the primary school on Shore Lane. I imagine they're inviting the parents of pupils there - it says here 'all welcome'.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Mmm, I might go to that if I have time.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: There's a couple of other talks - one giving advice about how to avoid injuries while doing exercise. It's on the ninth of March. Oh, it's a late afternoon talk, at four thirty, and it'll be in Room 6. It also says the talk is suitable for all ages. And finally, there's a talk called 'Stress Management' which is...
cues.speaker: WOMAN
